goal: Make CYNIC portable across N projects while preserving production-grade topology
constraints: no hardcoded project-specific URLs/tokens in runtime/core
keep repository topology declarations as policy sources
preserve existing organism contracts and MCP exposed tools
doc_policy: docs/ops/*.md are derived evidence/procedures, never source truth

roadmap.name: Identify hard couplings in runtime
acceptance: List of explicit coupling points with file:line references.

roadmap.name: Create project adapter interface package

steps.cmd: Create per-project adapter binding artifact for Kyon mobile transport/secrets/storage boundaries.
Create adapters in <project>/src/adapters/project for: secrets, transport, persistence, permissions.
Bind these adapters in bootstrap entry points only.
Define live-only validation steps and evidence contracts for non-simulated data checks.

acceptance: Domain and application layers compile with adapter interfaces only.
Onboarding JSON artifact contains complete, reproducible Kyon binding map.
Live verification has explicit pass criteria with structured output artifacts.

roadmap.name: Extract project contract schema

steps.cmd: Add JSON contract for project adapters
Version contract and document required keys

acceptance: Single JSON contract file exists with semver and change log.

roadmap.name: Bootstrap portability proof

steps.cmd: Prepare sample target repo mapping using only adapter overrides and JSON config.
Run compile + gate sequence for target mapping.

acceptance: At least one non-Kyon project boots CYNIC using only adapter/config swaps.
